name: agy-boost
description: Native, ultra-fast modding platform for Google Antigravity (Go + Pure TS + Wasm).

scripts.build:client: pnpm --dir src/client run build && cp src/client/dist/agy-boost.js src/cli/embedded/runtime.js && mkdir -p dist && cp src/client/dist/agy-boost.js dist/agy-boost.js
scripts.build: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:go
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:client && pnpm run build:go && pnpm run build:go:win && pnpm run build:go:linux
scripts.test:fast: pnpm run typecheck && go test -short ./src/... && pnpm run test:client
scripts.test:all: pnpm run typecheck && go test -v ./src/... && pnpm run test:client && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:all && pnpm run build
